# Agent assets and the routing policy

- `agents/policy/routing-policy.md` is the single routing policy, used verbatim by L1 (reference orchestrator system prompt), L2 (declarative agent instructions and skill) and L3 (Chat API `additionalContext`). Never fork it per layer (PLAN §9.2).
- Keep the rendered policy under 8,000 characters. Name business content (models, reports, measures); never include endpoints, tool names or authentication details (PLAN §9.7).
- `{{report_url:<model_key>}}` placeholders are filled in at build time; never commit real report URLs.
- The declarative agent uses manifest v1.9 with `capabilities: [{"name": "Fabric"}]`. Its instructions are generated by `scripts/build_agent.py` from the policy; don't edit generated files by hand.
- A policy change is a behaviour change: it must go through a pull request so the evaluation gate measures it.
